item.text: [{"task_id":"4093f84a","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    bar = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    step = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    axis = int(round(params['geometry'][1])) % len(grid.shape)","    work = grid.copy()","    turned = False","    columns = np.argwhere(np.all(work == bar, axis=axis)).flatten()","    if len(columns) == 0:","        work = work.T.copy()","        turned = True","        columns = np.argwhere(np.all(work == bar, axis=axis)).flatten()","    if len(columns) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    lo = int(np.min(columns))","    hi = int(np.max(columns))","    out = np.where(work == bar, bar, bg)","    for r in range(work.shape[0]):","        left = int(np.count_nonzero((work[r, :lo] != bg) & (work[r, :lo] != bar)))","        right = int(np.count_nonzero((work[r, hi + step:] != bg) & (work[r, hi + step:] != bar)))","        for k in range(left):","            c = lo - step * (k + step)","            if 0 <= c < work.shape[1]:","                out[r, c] = bar","        for k in range(right):","            c = hi + step * (k + step)","            if 0 <= c < work.shape[1]:","                out[r, c] = bar","    if turned:","        return out.T.copy()","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"geometry":[2]},"params":{"colors":[0,5],"geometry":[1,0]},"rationale":"The gray band attracts each colored dot perpendicular to its orientation. Count dots independently on each side in each aligned row or column, erase them, and pack the same number of gray cells against that side of the band. Multiple dots form contiguous extensions. Tensor weights specify background, band color, packing step, and the axis used to detect full band columns."}]
